work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letters CCXXXVII unite the public schools of Anagni with the seminary motu proprio and approve the municipality’s grants; LF51689 → LF51695 across running title LF51692; LF51757 → LF51766 across own provenance LF51760 and the left half ANNO of the page-358 running title LF51763; LF51830 → LF51842 across printer’s signature LF51833, the right half MDCCCXXXIX. LF51836 (same baseline as LF51763) and page number 359 LF51839; LF51810 carries a literal |; complete 9 August 1839 closing. Sheet number 49 LF51908 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF51647–51647; the source closing at LF51902–51905 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die nona augusti mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, ponti- ficatus Nostri anno nono, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
